pr_title: Increment Request Before Serializing it in OutboundHandler
pr_body:
If there are outside ways by which a request can be decremented (e.g.
due to cancelling a recovery concurrently) we may run into a situation where
we try to send a `refcount == 0` request. We have to avoid this by incrementing
a request before serializing and decrementing after it returns to make sure we
don't corrupt the request bytes while they're being serialized
or sent over the wire.

Closes #74253

comments: Hmm I wonder if this relates https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/74117 which added a missing `decRef()` around here.

@DaveCTurner I think the problem is that if a recovery is cancelled while the request is about to be sent, we will decrement the request and still try to send it. I think I have a reasonable fix for this :)
Ah yeah good catch, we should try and acquire another ref just for the sending too I guess.
